Used to compare you with typical values for your age and sex. They stay on your phone.

How it is calculated: each component is compared with a typical person of your age and sex and converted into years using the mortality risks published in studies of hundreds of thousands of people (VO2max: Kodama 2009; training: Arem 2015; sleep duration: Cappuccio 2010; regularity: Windred 2024), assuming that the risk doubles every ~8 years. The range accounts for measurement error and study uncertainty. Resting HR and HRV are not included: published references are measured while awake and are not comparable with night values. It is a statistical wellbeing estimate, not a medical assessment.
